title: Context and memory in an agent

items.stem: A student chats with your assistant on Monday and ends the session. Your team has not built any saving of notes or history. On Tuesday the student starts a new session. What does the model see at the start of it?

options.text: A short summary of Monday's chat that the model kept itself
Monday's full chat, because the same student is signed in
Only the system prompt, tool descriptions and the new message
Monday's tool results only, because tools store their outputs

items.stem: An agent request makes 4 model calls. The base context (system prompt, tool descriptions and question) is 1,000 tokens, and each step adds 500 tokens that stay in the message history. Every call re-sends the whole history. How many input tokens are billed in total across the 4 calls?

Midway through a request, the history holds a 6,000-token manual excerpt that has already been used to answer the student's first question. Three more calls will follow, on a different topic. Which change lowers the cost of those three calls most while keeping the agent's answer to the first question?

options.text: Clear the used excerpt from the history, but keep the answer given
Keep everything, because the model can only use what it sees
Move the excerpt to the end, so that the model recalls it better
Raise the window size so that the excerpt costs less per token

items.stem: A question has the embedding vector q = (1, 0), and a manual chunk has the embedding vector c = (3, 4). What is the cosine similarity of q and c, as a decimal?
The model answers correctly in call 3 using a tool result it received in call 1. The model itself stores nothing between calls. In one sentence, what carries that result from call 1 to call 3?
